title: Viwakilishi vya Nafsi (Theme 3: Mahusiano)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child chooses the pronoun by person and number and matches it with the verb prefix (sisi tu-) and, for the object, the marker inside the verb (-ni-, -ku-, -m-).
representations: a person table with verb prefixes
pointing to self, listener and others
steps: Who speaks, who listens, who is talked about?
Match the verb prefix and object marker.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Juma anamwambia Akinyi, "___ ni rafiki yangu."" Kwa nini "Mimi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Aliye anasema ni mimi, aliye anaambiwa ni wewe, anayezungumziwa ni yeye.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mama anamwambia mtoto, "___ unastahili sifa."" Kwa nini "Ninyi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Wewe ni mmoja, ninyi ni wengi. Mimi ni mmoja, sisi ni wengi.

misconceptions.ask: Sisi ni nafsi ipi? Kitenzi kianze na nini?
misconceptions.repair: Kiambishi cha kitenzi hupatana na nafsi: sisi tunacheza.

misconceptions.ask: Ni nani alisifiwa? Tunamwonyeshaje ndani ya kitenzi?
misconceptions.repair: Kitenzi hubeba nafsi ya mtendewa ndani yake: alinisifu.
